author: Leila Gharani
description:
Microsoft finally lets you move the Windows 11 taskbar again. I'll show you how to move it, clean up a cluttered Start menu, and turn off the web results in Windows search.

Free course: Windows 11 Essentials for Work. The built-in tools and shortcuts that make your workday easier 👉 https://www.xelplus.com/course/windows-essentials-for-work/

What You Will Learn in This Video:
In this breakdown, we dive into the most practical, time-saving features rolled out in recent Windows 11 updates (including versions 25H2 and 26H2). If the locked taskbar or a Start menu full of stuff you never use has been bugging you, you can finally fix both.

We cover:
- Total Taskbar Control: How to snap your taskbar to the left, right, or top, and the hidden setting to never combine taskbar buttons (hide labels).
- Start Menu Declutter: How to remove the "Recommended" section for a clean, distraction-free layout.

title: Windows 11 Finally Fixed the Taskbar. Here’s What Else Changed
